x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Update set per scope (Policy and Compliance, Risk, GRC common): - Entity types/filters, methodology, attestation templates, indicator templates - Notifications, workspace/dashboard configuration Content (data) per environment, in this order: 1. Authority documents → citations (UCF or import) 2. Policies → policy statements → statement-citation links 3. Entity types run → entities 4. Controls generate (verify counts against sub-prod) 5. Risk statements → risks generate 6. Migrated register rows (import set, keep source reference) Store apps must be the same version in every environment.
